evals.name: bootstraps-standards-index-with-confirmation
evals.prompt:
/review:setup

This repo has no docs/standards/ directory and no .claude/standards.yaml. It does have a hand-authored REVIEW.md at the repo root listing C# review criteria.
evals.expected_output: Reads state in the binding's order (concern file, index presence test, inference sources), finds no index, and uses the hand-authored REVIEW.md as an inference source for proposing index rows — requiring explicit confirmation before any conversion and never overwriting it. On acceptance it writes the skeleton index with standards-contract frontmatter at the binding's version plus the setup-owned docs/standards/.gitignore containing *.local.md, validates every row path, and writes .claude/standards.yaml only if the user relocates the root. Nothing is written before the user accepts.
expectations: Reads state in order: .claude/standards.yaml, then the index presence test, then inference sources
Treats the hand-authored REVIEW.md as an inference source and requires explicit confirmation before conversion, never overwriting it
Writes the skeleton index with standards-contract frontmatter at the binding's version
Creates the setup-owned <standards_dir>/.gitignore containing *.local.md and edits no other ignore file
Writes nothing until the user accepts

evals.name: second-run-is-a-no-op
evals.prompt:
/review:setup

This repo already has docs/standards/README.md with standards-contract frontmatter at the binding's current version, valid row paths, and a docs/standards/.gitignore containing *.local.md from a previous run.
evals.expected_output: Finds a conforming index at the binding's contract version via the presence test, validates the row paths, and short-circuits: reports the index healthy and proposes no changes — a second run produces no diff. No re-interview, no rewrite of the index or the overlay .gitignore, and no migration offer since the versions match.
expectations: Recognizes the conforming current-version index and proposes no changes (second run yields no diff)
Does not re-run the interview when the index is healthy at the binding's version
Does not offer migration when the index version matches the binding

evals.name: newer-index-never-downgraded
evals.prompt:
/review:setup

This repo's docs/standards/README.md carries standards-contract frontmatter at a NEWER version than this plugin's bundled contract binding.
evals.expected_output: Detects the directional version skew (index newer than the bundled contract), reports that the plugin should be updated, and stops: it never offers a migration, never rewrites the index to the older bundled version, and leaves every file untouched.
expectations: Detects that the index version is newer than the bundled contract version
Reports that the plugin should be updated rather than offering any migration
Never rewrites or downgrades the index
